主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, with a principal amount of $5,000,000. The notes are linked to the worst performing of two equity indices and are due on March 6, 2013. The filing also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian, Ontario, Quebec, and New York law. The report was filed on March 6, 2012.
